newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Western Areas restructures 1995 gold hedge.
newsitem.headline: Western Areas restructures 1995 gold hedge.

text.p: South Africa's Western Areas Gold Mining Co Ltd said on Tuesday that a 1995 hedging transaction had been restructured.
The firm said the hedge entailed the forward sale of 7.3 million ounces of gold and the purchase of call options on four million ounces of gold.

But it said, due to the recent fall in the price of bullion, that it had bought 1.6 million ounces of gold in the market to give it substantial upside exposure to any future rise in the price of the yellow metal.
"In addition, the restructuring obviates the need for medium-term funding," the mine said.
Shareholders were advised to exercise caution when dealing in the firm's shares until further details of the new hedge structure are published.
